items.en: UN Security Council condemns Houthi missile attacks and unauthorized Yemen flight landings.

items.en: US expects a deal 'soon' between Iran and Oman on Strait of Hormuz.

items.en: US intelligence assesses Russia could launch an attack to test NATO unity.

items.en: Syrian security forces neutralized two ISIS terrorists near Damascus.
items.he: כוחות הביטחון הסורים נטרלו שני מחבלי דאעש ליד דמשק.
